summary: Backend-only testing for SteelTrack iteration 3 (4 new features). Created /app/backend/tests/test_steeltrack_iter3_features.py with 21 tests covering: (1) Low-stock in /api/analytics/summary — new low_stock_threshold_pcs field + low_stock[] item shape (thickness/width/length/grade/pieces_available/theoretical_weight_available_kg) with 0 < pcs <= threshold; (2) /api/settings/low-stock — GET works for admin/office/labour; PATCH as admin to 5.5 persists and resets to 2.0; office + labour PATCH -> 403; (3) /api/parties — admin/office return sorted (case-insensitive) deduplicated non-empty string list, labour -> 403; (4) /api/vision/weight — 400 'Provide file or slip_photo_path' when neither given, 404 'Slip photo not found' for a non-existent slip_photo_path, 400 'Image too small' for a <500-byte file (actual OCR not invoked, per spec); (5) /api/reports/party-statement — labour -> 403, non-existent party -> 404 with 'No entries for party ...', full end-to-end flow: seeded inward entry -> office patched party_name='PYTEST Party One' -> POST returns {report_id, download_url (https:// + ?token=), email_id, sent_to, entries_count>=1} -> GET /api/reports/{id}.pdf?token=... returns 200 application/pdf with %PDF- magic, no-token -> 401, bogus token -> 401, office's main login JWT (Authorization header) -> 200. Full regression on existing endpoints passes. All 21 iter_3 tests pass (21/21). Pre-existing iter_1 (25) + iter_2 (16) tests still pass in isolation (62/62); one iter_2 analytics test is order-sensitive under parallel load — see flaky_tests note.

minor.issue: Resend blocks the seeded office email 'office@steeltrack.com' with HTTP 422 'Undeliverable recipient'. The backend correctly surfaces this as 502 'Failed to send email'. For end-to-end verification the test registers a Resend-deliverable office user (delivered@resend.dev). Consider changing the seeded office/admin/labour emails to Resend-verified addresses OR adding a dev override; otherwise the feature will fail for any human smoke-test using the default seeded office account.
No pagination/limit; distinct() over the full entries collection. Fine at current volume; worth adding a cap or indexed projection if entries grow.

Downloads over 'inline' Content-Disposition; browsers may preview rather than download. Minor UX detail. Signed JWT is passed in query string (same mild concern as /entries.csv?token=... — appears in access logs).

action_items: No functional fixes required — all 13 review-request bullets pass, and the Resend integration is confirmed working against a deliverable recipient (202 Accepted logged in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log).

Decide whether to update the seeded office/admin/labour emails from *@steeltrack.com to Resend-verified / delivered@resend.dev-style addresses, so a manual demo of the 'email PDF' feature does not fail at Resend's deliverability check.
(Carried from iter_2) server.py is 1370 lines — split into routers (auth, entries, inventory, analytics, voice, vision, reports, settings) before next iteration.
(Carried from iter_1/iter_2) Analytics endpoint has no RBAC — any logged-in user can see totals + low_stock; spec allows this but main agent should confirm.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew from 906 to 1370 lines after this iteration (vision + reports + email + settings all inline). The 700-line split threshold is now well exceeded — refactor to routers is strongly recommended.

/api/reports/party-statement calls _assert_safe_email (anti-phishing anchor check) with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (fallback hard-codes 'https://weight-check-30.preview.emergentagent.com'). Keep the fallback in sync with .env — otherwise the download link in the email could point to a stale host.

download_report accepts the signed report-scoped token OR a full admin/office login JWT. The token-scope check '(rep_id_scope is None or rep_id_scope == report_id)' correctly rejects a signed token issued for ANOTHER report (verified by code reading).
/api/vision/weight uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with gpt-4o-mini and 500-byte minimum guard; sync _sync_get_object is correctly off-loaded via run_in_threadpool.
/api/parties uses db.entries.distinct('party_name') — fine; return type is List[str] (JSON array of strings), matches spec.
PATCH /api/settings/low-stock updates in a single $set upsert — good, idempotent and race-safe.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 iter_3; 62/62 in isolation across all iterations)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_LS_*, TEST_RPT_*, TEST_REG_* grades and a few inward/outward entries, one entry patched with party_name='PYTEST Party One'. One admin-registered office user 'delivered@resend.dev' (safe Resend test inbox) is created on first run and reused on subsequent runs. No cleanup — safe on isolated preview DB.

flaky_tests.issue: Passes in isolation and in iter_2's own run (16/16) but can fail under parallel-worker load because 'totals_today' is read before, then compared to after; other parallel inwards inflate the delta. Not an application bug — tighten the test by filtering on created_by in a future iteration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Seeded users unchanged (admin/office/labour@steeltrack.com). IMPORTANT for anything that triggers Resend: Resend's provider blocks 'office@steeltrack.com' as 'Undeliverable recipient' (HTTP 422), which the backend surfaces as 502. Use 'delivered@resend.dev' (register via POST /api/auth/register as admin) for end-to-end email tests. The iter_3 report flow test already does this; subsequent runs of the test idempotently re-use the account (accepts 400 'Email already exists'). PDF download accepts BOTH the signed ?token= (JWT with report_id claim, 24h) AND a full admin/office login JWT. For next iterations, server.py (1370 lines) really should be split.
rca_of_issue: First run of the full flow test failed with 502. Root cause: Resend returns 422 'Undeliverable recipient' for the seeded office@steeltrack.com — the integrations.emergentagent.com /api/v1/email/send proxy forwards Resend's deliverability guard. The backend's _send_email catches httpx.HTTPStatusError and re-raises HTTPException(502). Fix (test-side): register a new office user with 'delivered@resend.dev' (a Resend-guaranteed deliverable mailbox) and run the flow as that user. Reproduction: POST /api/reports/party-statement with any party_name that has >=1 entry while logged in as office@steeltrack.com — observe 502 in response and 'Email send failed: 422 Undeliverable recipient' in backend logs.
